questions.question: In which of the following states of India is Hojagiri dance predominantly performed?
questions.solution:
Hojagiri is a famous folk dance from the state of Tripura, performed primarily by the Reang (Bru) clan. It involves balancing props like bottles and lamps on the head while performing complex waist and lower-body movements.

Note: It is traditionally performed during the Laxmi Puja festival following the harvest.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian classical dancers is associated with Kuchipudi?
questions.solution:
Vempati Chinna Satyam was a legendary dancer and guru of Kuchipudi. He is credited with modernizing the dance form and establishing the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai to popularize it globally.

Additional Info: Other artists like Sanjukta Panigrahi are famous for Odissi.

questions.question: In which of the following states is the Chu-Faat dance performed?
questions.solution:
Chu-Faat is a traditional folk dance performed in Sikkim by the Lepcha tribe. The dance is performed in honor of the peaks of Mount Kanchenjunga, which is considered a guardian deity by the local people.

Key Fact: The term literally refers to the ritual offerings made during the prayer ceremonies.

questions.question: Who among the following dancers was the first one from the state of Odisha to be conferred the Padma Vibhushan Award?
questions.solution:
Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was the first person from Odisha to be honored with the Padma Vibhushan (in 2000). He was the primary architect of the 20th-century revival of Odissi classical dance.

Note: He was a master of the Pakhawaj drum as well as an exceptional dancer and choreographer.

questions.question: The Kuchipudi dance belongs to which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Kuchipudi is a classical dance form that originated in the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh. It is unique for its Tarangam sequence, where dancers balance on the rim of a brass plate.

Context: Traditionally performed by men (called Bhagavatulu), it has evolved into a leading solo performance art for women.

questions.question: For which of the following tribal music and dance forms was Arjun Singh Dhurve conferred with Tulsi Samman?
questions.solution:
Arjun Singh Dhurve is a prominent folk artist from Madhya Pradesh associated with the Baiga tribal music and dance. He was awarded the Tulsi Samman for his efforts in preserving the Gudum Baja and Baiga Pardhauni traditions.

Note: He was also conferred with the Padma Shri in 2022.

questions.question: ‘Kuki dance’ is a folk dance of India that is predominantly performed in _________.
questions.solution:
The Kuki dance (often referring to the Bamboo Dance or Chailam) is a folk dance predominantly performed by the Kuki-Chin-Mizo groups in Nagaland and Manipur.

Note: These dances often use rhythmic bamboo movements or celebrate victorious moments in tribal history.

questions.question: Fugdi dance is associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Fugdi is an extremely popular folk dance of Goa and coastal Maharashtra, performed by women during Hindu festivals like Ganesh Chaturthi. Dancers form circles or pairs and move with high speed while making a whistling sound ('Foo').

Context: It is a non-ceremonial dance that reflects the joy and bond between rural women.

questions.question: Yakshagan is a folk dance of which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Yakshagana is a traditional theater-dance form from Karnataka that combines dance, music, dialogue, and elaborate costumes. It typically depicts stories from the Ramayana and Mahabharata.

Sub-styles: It is broadly divided into Tenkutittu (Southern style) and Badagutittu (Northern style).

questions.question: In which of the following cities of Manipur is the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy located?
questions.solution:
The Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy, a premier institution for the training of Manipuri dance and music, is located in Imphal.

Status: It is a constituent unit of the Sangeet Natak Akademi and serves as a vital center for the Lai Haraoba and Ras-Lila traditions.

questions.question: In which of the following states is the Nrityagram, an Odissi dance institution, located?
questions.solution:
Nrityagram, India's first residential 'dance village', is located near Hessaraghatta in Karnataka. It was founded by the famous Odissi dancer Protima Gauri in 1990.

Unique Feature: Though located in Karnataka, it is world-renowned as a center for excellence in Odissi training following the Guru-Shishya parampara.

questions.question: Mohiniyattam is associated with which of the following traditional dance styles?
questions.solution:
Mohiniyattam, the classical dance of Kerala, is characterized by the Lasya style, which emphasizes grace, beauty, and feminine movements.

Terminology: Unlike the Tandava (vigorous) style, Mohiniyattam focuses on soft footwork and circular body sways, mimicking the palm trees and backwaters of Kerala.

questions.question: In which year was the National Institute of Kathak Dance established?
questions.solution:
The National Institute of Kathak Dance (also known as Kathak Kendra) was established in 1964 in New Delhi.

Note: It is the premier institution for Kathak in India and was led for many years by the legendary Pandit Birju Maharaj.

questions.question: Bharatanatyam dance style is associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Bharatanatyam is the oldest and most popular classical dance form of India, originating from Tamil Nadu. It was historically known as Sadir Attam and was performed by Devadasis in temples.

Key Fact: It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and spectacular footwork.

questions.question: Chittani Ramachandra Hegde was associated with which of the following dances?
questions.solution:
Chittani Ramachandra Hegde was a legendary performer of Yakshagana from Karnataka. He was the first Yakshagana artist to be honored with the Padma Shri award.

Legacy: He was famous for his versatile acting and mastery over both 'heroic' and 'demonic' characters in the Yakshagana repertoire.

questions.question: When was the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy established?
questions.solution:
The Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA) was established in 1954 in Imphal.

Background: It was inaugurated by India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, to nurture and promote the unique Manipuri Ras-Lila and Pung Cholom styles.

questions.question: Kathakali, one of the classical dances of India, is predominantly performed in which of the following states of India?
questions.solution:
Kathakali is a highly stylized classical 'dance-drama' from Kerala. It is famous for its massive, colorful costumes and elaborate facial makeup that indicates the nature of the characters (e.g., Green for heroes, Red/Black for villains).

Performance: It is traditionally performed throughout the night in temple courtyards.

questions.question: Which of the following institutes was founded by Mrinalini Sarabhai who was a Bharatanatyam and Kathakali dancer?
questions.option_1: Sri Thyagaraja College of Music and Dance
questions.solution:
Mrinalini Sarabhai, an expert in Bharatanatyam and Kathakali, founded the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad in 1949.

Note: She was the wife of the famous scientist Vikram Sarabhai and mother of dancer Mallika Sarabhai.

questions.question: Khuallam is a famous dance of:
questions.solution:
Khuallam (literally 'Dance of the Guests') is a popular folk dance of Mizoram. It is traditionally performed by men wearing the hand-woven Mizo cloth known as Puandum during the Khuangchawi ceremony.

Visual: Dancers move to the rhythmic beats of gongs, symbolizing community hospitality.

questions.question: Ranjana Gauhar was awarded the Padma Shri Award (2003) for her contribution to which of the following Indian dance forms?
questions.solution:
Ranjana Gauhar is a leading Odissi dancer who was awarded the Padma Shri in 2003. She is known for her graceful style and for founding Utsav - Educational and Cultural Society.

Contribution: Apart from being a performer, she is a noted author and filmmaker documenting Indian dance heritage.

questions.question: Which of the following is India’s national academy of dance?
questions.option_4: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training
questions.solution:
The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama. Established by the Government of India in 1952, it is the highest body for the performing arts in the country.

Function: It grants the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards and confers 'Classical' status on dance forms.

questions.question: Tera Tali folk dance is primarily associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Tera Tali is a complex folk dance of Rajasthan, performed by the Kamar tribe. Women perform while sitting, with 13 Manjiras (small brass cymbals) tied to various parts of their bodies, which they strike in rhythm with hand-held cymbals.

Note: It is often performed in honor of the folk deity Baba Ramdev.

questions.question: Identify the Indian classical dancer associated with Kathak.
questions.solution:
Rohini Bhate was a distinguished Kathak dancer and scholar from Pune, belonging to the Jaipur and Lucknow gharanas. She founded the Nrityabharati Kathak Academy.

Note: Kelucharan Mohapatra (Odissi) and Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma (Kuchipudi) represent other dance forms.

questions.question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated in Madhya Pradesh?
questions.solution:
The Khajuraho Dance Festival is a world-famous annual event held in Madhya Pradesh against the backdrop of the UNESCO World Heritage Khajuraho Temples.

Significance: It features performances by India's leading classical dancers and promotes cultural tourism in the region.

questions.question: Matki dance is the famous folk dance associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Matki dance is a folk dance of the Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh. It is performed by women who balance a Matki (earthen pot) on their heads while dancing to the beats of a drum.

Context: It is usually performed solo at weddings or festivals, showing great balance and poise.

questions.question: ‘Padayani’, a local dance form primarily performed in ________ to please Goddess Bhadrakali.
questions.solution:
Padayani (or Padeni) is a traditional ritualistic dance-drama from Kerala, performed in Bhadrakali temples. Dancers wear massive masks (Kolams) made of areca nut palm fronds.

Theme: The performance is intended to appease the goddess and ward off evil, featuring characters like Bhairavi and Kalan.

questions.question: With which of the following dances is Yamini Krishnamurthy associated?
questions.solution:
Yamini Krishnamurthy is a legendary figure who excels in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi. She was the 'Asthana Nartaki' (resident dancer) of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam.

Award: She has received all three Padma awards: Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.

questions.question: Who among the following classical dancers is NOT related to Odissi?
questions.solution:
Geetanjali Lal is a renowned maestro of Kathak (Jaipur Gharana), not Odissi.
  • Mayadhar Raut: A legendary guru who helped systemize Odissi.
  • Kumkum Mohanty: A famous Odissi dancer and Padma Shri awardee.
  • Kiran Segal: An eminent Odissi exponent.

questions.question: Elelakkaradi dance of Kerala is performed by which of the following tribes?
questions.solution:
Elelakkaradi is a highly rhythmic tribal dance performed by the Irular tribe of the Attappady region in Kerala.

Theme: The dance mimics the struggle of the tribe against wild animals, particularly bears (Karadi), and is accompanied by vigorous drumming and shouting.

questions.question: Bhupen Hazarika was one of the most well-known personalities from the state of ________.
questions.solution:
Bhupen Hazarika, popularly known as the 'Bard of Brahmaputra', was a legendary singer, filmmaker, and musician from Assam.

Honors: He was posthumously awarded India's highest civilian honor, the Bharat Ratna, in 2019. He was also instrumental in promoting Sattriya dance.

questions.question: In which of the following states is Govindji Nartanalaya located?
questions.solution:
Govindji Nartanalaya is a prominent institute for Manipuri dance, located in Imphal, Manipur.

Context: It was established under the patronage of the royal family to preserve the classical Ras-Lila and Sankirtana traditions of the state.
